sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The "Ex-gratia Scheme: Disability Compensation'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to the registered worker in the event of complete or partial disability.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Sector: Financial assistance

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Ex-gratia Scheme: Disability Compensation&#39;&#39; by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme for the registered workers of the board. Under this scheme, the Board shall provide compensation to the registered worker in the event of complete or partial disability who do not have Health Cards under Bhagat Puran Singh Sehat Bima Yojna.

**Benefits / Assistance:** - **Compensation for Complete Disability:** Ex-gratia amount of ₹4,00,000/-. - **Compensation for Partial Disability:** Proportionate amount of ₹4,00,000/- shall be given on the basis of percentage of disability i.e., ₹4,000/- for each 1% disability and maximum of ₹4,00,000/-.

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process as a Building/ Construction Worker:** - For new registration of workers please approach the nearby Sewa Kendra or Registering officers/ Labour Inspector. > ***Application Process of the Welfare Scheme:*** - To apply for benefits of the concerned welfare scheme, please approach to nearby Sewa Kendra or Registering Officers/ Labour Inspector of your area. > ***Note:*** - **Registration with the Board:** A construction worker becomes a member of the board by filling out Application Form No 28 along with depositing registration fees of ₹ 25/- only (once in life) and ₹ 10/- per month as contribution fees. A worker at a time can get himself registered for a minimum period of 1 year &amp; maximum period of 5 years. The registered worker is called &#39;Beneficiary&#39; of the Board. > **Important Links:** - **Check Your Registration Application Status:** Registered workers can check their registration application status through visiting this [link ](http://bocw.punjab.gov.in/Login.aspx?Id=1)upon entering their Registration Number. - **Download Registration Card:** Registered workers can download their registration Registration Card through visiting this [link ](https://bocw.punjab.gov.in/Login.aspx?Id=1)upon entering their Registration Number. - **Check your Scheme Application Status:** Registered workers can check their scheme application status through visiting this [link ](https://bocw.punjab.gov.in/Login.aspx?Id=1)upon entering their Registration Number. - **CSC Locator:** Visit this [link ](https://www.apnacsconline.in/csc-locator/punjab/)to search nearest Common Service Center (CSC) of your area. - **List of Sewa** **Kendra:** Visit this [link ](https://punjab.gov.in/documents/10191/1112286/Final+List-V1.0.pdf/6ab437f3-f04c-427d-a2b7-dd49515f075b)to see the list of Sewa Kendra. > **Helpdesk:** > Punjab Building And Other Construction Workers Welfare Board > **Address:** Labour Bhawan Model Welfare Centre Phase 10, Sector 64, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab, 160062 > **Phone :** +91 172-2540125 > **Email :** bocwhq@gmail.com > **For Bocw Portal Related Queries (Technical Support):-** > **Phone :** +91 172-2540125 > **Email :** bocwhq@gmail.com > **Office Visiting Hours :** Monday to Friday > (09:00 AM to 05:00 PM)

**Additional Application Processes:** **Process 2:** > ***Registration Process as a Building/ Construction Worker:*** **Step 1:** To register as a beneficiary under the BOCW Welfare Board, an applicant worker should download [Form No-28](http://bocw.punjab.gov.in/userfiles/file/Registration%20Form%2028%20updated.pdf) and attach all the mandatory documents (self attested, if required). **Step 2:** Application shall be submitted to the Labour Inspector of your area. > ***Application Process of the Welfare Scheme:*** **Step 1:** A registered worker should download [Form No-37](https://bocw.punjab.gov.in/userfiles/file/BOCW%20Scheme%20Forms/Exgratio%20Form%2037.pdf) and attach all the mandatory documents (self attested, if required). **Step 2:** Application shall be submitted to the Labour Inspectors of your area. &gt; ***Note:*** - **Registration with the Board:** A construction worker becomes a member of the board by filling out Application Form No 28 along with depositing registration fees of ₹ 25/- only (once in life) and ₹ 10/- per month as contribution fees. A worker at a time can get himself registered for a minimum period of 1 year &amp;amp; maximum period of 5 years.
